runnable.label: Measurable
runnable.says: Measure runs the tasks with it and without it, so the difference is its effect.

same.label: In Every Run
same.says: Already in the repo, so every trial starts with it, with and without the change. To measure a change to it, edit it (or add a new one) and pick that as the change on Measure.

not_yet.label: Not Measurable Yet
not_yet.says: Measure can't run this kind of change yet. It goes in the build brief.

before_after.label: Changes the Code
before_after.says: Changes the app's code, so it is measured before and after: make the change on a branch (or leave it uncommitted), then Measure runs the tasks on the commit before and on the change. It goes in the build brief too.

brief.label: Brief Only
brief.says: Goes in the build brief as a task. There is nothing here for Measure to run.

note.label: Diagram Note
note.says: Only fixes the diagram: nothing changes in the code, so there is nothing to measure.

enables.label: Adds a Task
enables.says: Adds a task with a check, so Measure can test this step.

step.label: Tasks Run Here
step.says: Measure runs this step's tasks; a skill linked to it is measured on them.

check.label: Runs the Checks
check.says: The repo's tests, which a task's check can call. The same in every trial.

app.label: App Part
app.says: Part of the app, not the agent: Measure doesn't change it. Change it on a branch, and Measure runs the tasks before and after the change.

planned.label: Not Written Yet
planned.says: Planned: BUILD.md asks for it. Write it first; then it can be measured.

absent.label: Not in the Repo
absent.says: The repo doesn't have one, so there is nothing to measure.

not_installed.label: Not Installed
not_installed.says: Install a skill from it first (pick one in its details); then Measure can run it.

lanes.setup: Measure tests what you add or change here
lanes.flow: Measure runs the tasks on these steps

before_after.mode: A Code Change: Before and After
before_after.mode_agent: An Agent Change: With and Without
before_after.lead: Make the change on a branch (or leave it uncommitted), then measure it against the commit before. Rig doesn't write the change; you or your agent do.
before_after.compare: Before: the code at {base}. After: the code at {after}. Each arm's tasks and checks run on its own copy of that code, and its agent setup (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks) is whatever that code has.
before_after.same: {after} has the same code as {base}, so a run would measure nothing. Make the change on a branch (or leave it uncommitted), then measure that.
before_after.not_git: This repo isn't a git repo with a commit, so there is no commit to measure before and after. Commit it with git first.
before_after.unknown_ref: {ref} isn't a commit or branch in this repo.
before_after.name: {base} → {after}
before_after.key: Before vs after: "after" is the code at {after}, "before" the code at {base}.
before_after.for: Measuring “{title}”: pick the branch, commit or uncommitted changes that make it as the After side.

stage_lead.agent: Choose the tasks, then run the change on them with and without it. Each result gets a Rig score.
stage_lead.code: Choose the tasks, then run them on the code before and after the change. Each result gets a Rig score.

run_says.agent: Every task runs twice, with and without the change, so the difference is the change's.
run_says.code: Every task runs twice, on the code before and after the change, so the difference is the change's.

empty.title: Nothing Here Measure Can Run Yet
empty.lead: Measure runs {kinds}, with and without, on your tasks. Add a skill on Build (from the library, or drag it onto the canvas), or add or edit a CLAUDE.md, hook or MCP server in the repo.

templates.label: Fewer Tokens at the Same Pass Rate
templates.text: Use fewer tokens on each task in this repo, without lowering how many tasks the agent gets right.

templates.label: Lower Cost per Task
templates.text: Spend less per task in this repo, at the same pass rate.

templates.label: Fewer Wrong Bug Fixes
templates.text: Fix bugs in this repo right the first time: fewer fixes that look done but break something else.

templates.label: Always Runs the Tests
templates.text: Always run this repo's tests before finishing, and show their output.

templates.label: Follows Our Conventions
templates.text: Follow this repo's conventions: code style, where things go, naming, and what not to touch.

templates.label: Finishes Faster
templates.text: Finish tasks in this repo faster, at the same pass rate.
